etymology.root: French monopole, from Greek monos (single) + pōlein (to sell)

text.what: A named vineyard held whole by one owner. Rare in Burgundy, where inheritance splits everything, and printed on the label whenever it is true.

kin.as: The opposite case: one name, eighty owners.
